chippy_fryer.text: Cod or haddock? In Lancashire it's cod, mostly, over the Pennines they'll swear by haddock. I fry in beef dripping, the old way. Vegetable oil on Fridays for the vegetarians.
Salt and vinegar? Gravy? Curry sauce? A pea wet, that's the juice off the mushy peas, poured over? Go on.
